verdict.rationale: Titan ships no fleet-management surface of its own. The only org-scale signal is a probe note that fleet management runs through the Google Workspace Admin console, a separate product whose capabilities are not documented here. The first-party docs cover only per-user enrollment and removal of a key from an individual account. Missing for 10: evidence of pre-registration of keys to users, bulk configuration, lifecycle/inventory tracking of issued keys, any admin-facing docs or hands-on corroboration of Workspace-based provisioning.
